clips.title: The story
paras: At the Barrens border, Kadrak sends a Horde champion into Stonetalon Peak after a missive is intercepted. The champion is to kill the dryad Rynthariel and plant a Horde banner inside the Talon Den.

Kadrak watches the Barrens' northern boundary for Alliance and night elf incursions. After a messenger carrying a runed scroll is cut down, he decodes the missive and traces it to Rynthariel the Keymaster, an influential dryad in Stonetalon Peak. Kadrak chooses to strike rather than simply guard the mountain passes, hoping to deter future scouts from probing Horde territory.

Horde warriors enter the Talon Den, a cavern overlooking Stonetalon Peak. Killing Rynthariel deals a blow to local night elf coordination. Kadrak's banner is planted inside the cave, its red standard marking the heart of dryad territory with a warning: incursions into the Barrens will meet decisive violence.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This scroll is from that scheming dryad Rynthariel, Keymaster of the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak.
She'll not be making any more contact with the messenger you looted this from, heh, but we must stand our ground here. The Horde will not tolerate her outrunners here.

Friend, travel to the Talon Den. Kill Rynthariel, and then put up a symbol for all to see. Take this Horde flag, friend. Put it up in the Talon Den so that they will not be so rash as to send another messenger through our territory again.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We cannot allow the Alliance on our land, friend. Make this known.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're a tough one! Ridding the Den of Rynthariel is a major step, friend. They will be slow to regroup, and so we can count on less Alliance runners in the Barrens. They will think again before sending another this way.
